title: ValidatorProgressResponseV1
description: 200 response body for GET /v1/decisions/{decisionId}/validators (Milestone 7). Mirrors real per-validator subprocess lifecycle events, never a timer or a fabricated state -- see docs/public-demo-boundary.md. Carries only validatorId, phase, updatedAt, and (once available) the validated outputHash: never raw stdout/stderr, error detail, file paths, or key material. An empty validators array means the decision exists but hasn't started running validators yet (still PENDING).
